head: 4f7f59718e29240225ab65a3f6d3ab6915e97057
summary: The release approval accepts the sdlc:release-approved label from any non-bot account (label_approval checks only is_automation_actor, never is_owner_actor), so a collaborator with only Triage access can label a merged build PR and make sdlc-release.yml run deploy.command to production, or make the production-gate hook allow a guarded command, without the owner's act that decision 34 and OPERATING_MODEL section 1 (one person holds the release manager role) require.
